Encompass Health new entrant OR competitor inpatient rehabilitation hospitals Select Medical Lifepoint 2026

findings.claim: 10-K：IRF 業除 EHC 外高度分散，主要對手為急性醫院內的復健單位（92% 患者來自急性醫院）；另有一家公開公司經營 38 家 IRF；CON 為進入障礙。
findings.excerpt: The inpatient rehabilitation industry, outside of our leading position, is highly fragmented. Our inpatient rehabilitation hospitals compete primarily with rehabilitation units, most of which are within acute-care hospitals, in the markets we serve.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：急性醫院系統可能擴張復健服務；2023 年南卡羅來納廢除 IRF 的 CON，CON 弱化可能提高競爭。
findings.excerpt: For example, in 2023, South Carolina enacted legislation to repeal CON regulations for several provider types, including IRFs.

findings.claim: 搜尋未找到 2026 年 IRF 新進入者或具體份額消長數據；聚合站未提供可靠 IRF 份額。
findings.source: WebSearch 結果彙整（csimarket/IBISWorld 等聚合站）

note: 無一手來源顯示具體新進入者或份額數字；聚合站競爭者名單不可靠。
